entries.name: Certified Supplier Quality Professional
entries.definition: An ASQ certification for professionals who assess and manage the quality of suppliers.

entries.name: Certified Surgical Technologist
entries.definition: A certification for surgical technologists, awarded by the National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting.

entries.name: Certified Technical Trainer
entries.definition: A certification showing that a trainer can plan and deliver technical training effectively.

entries.name: Certified Technology Specialist
entries.definition: An AVIXA certification for audiovisual professionals.

entries.name: Certified TestStand Developer
entries.definition: A National Instruments certification for developers of automated test sequences with NI TestStand.

entries.name: Certified Transport Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for patients during air and ground transport, awarded by the Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing.

entries.name: Certified Urologic Physician Assistant
entries.definition: A certification for physician assistants in urology, awarded by the Certification Board for Urologic Nurses and Associates.

entries.name: Certified Urologic Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses in urology, awarded by the Certification Board for Urologic Nurses and Associates.

entries.name: Certified Wine Educator
entries.definition: An advanced wine teaching certification awarded by the Society of Wine Educators.

entries.name: Certified Wound and Ostomy Care Nurse
entries.definition: A nursing certification for nurses who care for people with wounds and ostomies.

entries.name: Certified Wound Care Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who specialise in wound care, awarded by the Wound, Ostomy and Continence Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Change Management Certified Professional
entries.definition: A certification in the principles and practice of organisational change management.

entries.name: Chartered Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development
entries.definition: The highest membership grade of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development, held by senior HR and people-development professionals.
variants: Chartered Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (FCIPD)

entries.name: Chartered Member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development
entries.definition: A membership grade of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development for experienced HR and people-development professionals.
variants: Chartered Member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (MCIPD)

entries.name: Chauffeur license
entries.definition: A driver's licence, issued by a state or country, that permits the holder to drive vehicles for hire.

entries.name: Cisco Certified Support Technician
entries.definition: An entry-level Cisco certification for people starting out in IT support, networking or cybersecurity roles.

entries.name: Citrix Certified Administrator
entries.definition: A Citrix certification showing that a person can administer Citrix products such as application and desktop virtualisation.

entries.name: Citrix Certified Integration Architect
entries.definition: A Citrix certification for architects who design integrated solutions built on Citrix products.

entries.name: Class B commercial driver's license
entries.definition: A US state-issued commercial driver's license for driving a single heavy vehicle, or one towing a light trailer.

entries.name: Class C commercial driver's license
entries.definition: A US state-issued commercial driver's license for vehicles that fit neither Class A nor Class B but carry 16 or more passengers or hazardous materials that need placards.

entries.name: Combat Lifesaver
entries.definition: A US Army course and designation in advanced first aid for battlefield injuries, given to soldiers who are not medics.

entries.name: CompTIA A+
entries.definition: A CompTIA entry-level certification showing skills in supporting and troubleshooting computer hardware, operating systems and networks.

entries.name: CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+)
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for experienced security practitioners, covering advanced enterprise security architecture, operations and risk management.

entries.name: CompTIA CDIA+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for document imaging professionals, covering the planning and design of document imaging systems.

entries.name: CompTIA Cloud+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the configuration, deployment, security and management of cloud infrastructure.

entries.name: CompTIA Cloud Admin Professional (CCAP)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for cloud administration.

entries.name: CompTIA Cloud Essentials+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the business and technical fundamentals of cloud computing.

entries.name: CompTIA Convergence Technologies Professional (CTP+)
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering convergence technologies, the combining of voice, video and data on shared networks.

entries.name: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for security analysts, covering threat detection, vulnerability management and incident response.

entries.name: CompTIA Digital Home Technology Integrator (DHTI+)
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for technicians who install and integrate technology systems in homes.

entries.name: CompTIA e-Biz+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the concepts and technology of electronic business.

entries.name: CompTIA Green IT Specialist
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering environmentally responsible use and management of IT equipment.

entries.name: CompTIA Healthcare IT Technician
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for IT technicians who support healthcare settings, covering topics such as electronic health records and healthcare regulations.

entries.name: CompTIA HTI+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for home technology integrators who install and integrate technology systems in homes.

entries.name: CompTIA i-Net+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering foundational knowledge of Internet, intranet and extranet technologies.

entries.name: CompTIA Instructor+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification for people who deliver technical training, covering classroom instruction skills.

entries.name: CompTIA IT for Sales
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering IT concepts and terminology for people who sell technology products and services.

entries.name: CompTIA IT Fundamentals+
entries.definition: A CompTIA entry-level certification covering basic IT concepts such as hardware, software, networking and security.

entries.name: CompTIA IT Operations Specialist (CIOS)
entries.definition: A CompTIA stackable certification awarded for holding a specified combination of other CompTIA certifications, for IT operations.

entries.name: CompTIA Linux+
entries.definition: A CompTIA certification covering the installation, configuration, security and troubleshooting of Linux systems.
